description: Query a collection for documents nearest to the given query texts.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection to query.

include.description: Fields to include in the results, such as documents, metadatas, embeddings, or distances.

n_results.description: Maximum number of results to return for each query text.

query_texts.description: Query texts to find the nearest documents for.

where.description: Metadata filter to apply to the query.

where_document.description: Document-content filter to apply to the query.

name: chroma_query_documents
